svg.text: dashed: each arc continued as a meridian
of a sphere of radius nR
One drawing, one period T, nothing else
Arc swept in one period: Ln = αn · nR = 2πR / √n
Its speed and pull: vn = Ln / T, an = vn2 / rn = Ln2 rn / (T2 rn2)
Invariant of the drawing: Ln2 rn = 4π2R3 for every n
⇒ an rn2 = 4π2R3 / T2 = μ, so an = μ / rn2
Arc = meridian of a sphere of area 4πrn2: Φ = an · 4πrn2 = 4πμ
the same flux through every sphere
The source of the field: M = μ = Φ / 4π (L3T−2), like q = ΦE / 4π
Newton (1684) obtained 1/r² from Kepler’s third law in the same way;
here it is read off the 3/2 drawing (circular orbits). The static invariant
L²r = 4π²R³ equals μT²: the same source, measured in the body’s own period.
